name: desire for parenthood
quote: I hope our baby gets your eyes.
description: Feeling ready for the joys and responsibilities of raising a child.
perceptions: A major milestone in life is to have a child.
I'm as ready as I'll ever be to raise a child.

guidance.description: Children are pretty resilient, but they thrive best in a household that is prepared for them.

variations.name: parenthood as pretext
variations.description: Disingenuous spoken support for parenthood as a way to move forward in a physical relationship.
perceptions: My partner is more likely to get physical if s/he thinks I'm ready to raise a family.

commentaries.quote: Through most of history, it didn't matter if you were 'ready' for parenthood. Mating happens, parenthood comes, and you deal with it. Fortunately, we live in a time where people can delay being parents to balance the biology with life circumstances.

Some people may never feel this desire unambiguously because they're mentally aware of how being a parent will change their lives. A tentative sense of readiness is the best some will get, and then the calendar or grandparents may push the decision.
There is no such thing as a perfect parent, so just be a real one.
The best part about being a parent is the moment you realize you wouldn't want your life any other way.
